name: pre-read-after-a-stale-deny-of-other-bytes-denies-as-out-of-band
description: #514: the Read after a stale deny is admitted only for the bytes the coordinator recorded. Sessions A and B read v1 and B commits v2, which makes A's copy INVALID; A's Read of the v2 bytes B committed is denied with the commit text (fixture 01). The file then changes with no commit, and A's next Read offers those bytes. It is denied with the out-of-band text, which names a commit through the coordinator as what clears it and promises no Read; admitting it would let A's next Edit build on bytes no version records. No session holds an uncommitted write (B's commit left it MODIFIED), so the write-in-flight text does not apply.

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Stale read denied: CLAUDE.md on disk does not match v2, the last version committed through the coordinator, and no session committed the change, so it was made outside the coordinator. Do not restore or overwrite CLAUDE.md: the change may be your user's work. Tell your user that CLAUDE.md changed outside the coordinator; the read stays denied until the change is committed through the coordinator. This denial is structural (v0.2 strict mode); retrying the same operation will produce the same denial.
